acceptance_rule: Each of two independent comparisons: S/A point estimate > 0 and paired complete-block CI95 lower bound > 0; S/D point estimate and CI95 lower bound > 0. The 1% point and confidence-bound targets are optional diagnostics. D/A is a diagnostic control. Require bitwise operator outputs and identical per-rank loss/gradient trajectories.
limitation: Fixed synthetic inputs and this configuration only; no long-term convergence claim.
